title: gpt-oss:120b - thinking being returned in tool calls
body:
### What is the issue?

I can reliably reproduce this bug. In the log file below I am logging the input to the model. Then I log the exception being thrown from the ollama python lib which shows it trying to parse the tool call which appears to be the text that should be returned in the thinking section. I retry the same request (5 times in this case) and eventually the model starts to return nothing.

At this point a failure condition is triggered in my code which results in me retrying the entire conversation again and the model continues to return nothing until my code fails and exits. 

This seems to happen everytime for this particular system prompt. Other system prompts I have that demand returning json and use the same tools seem to work fine.
```
larry@llm1:~$ ollama -v
ollama version is 0.11.10

larry@llm1:~$sytemctl edit ollama 
[Service]
Environment="OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1"
Environment="OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0"
Environment="OLLAMA_MODELS=/storage4tb/models/ollama"
Environment="OLLAMA_DEBUG=1"
Environment="OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434"
Environment="OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*"
Environment="OLLAMA_NEW_ESTIMATES=1"
```
